text:
Juno (People Ops): Quick note — new hire Marco Santos starts tomorrow. Running late-night checklist: I-9, bg check, W-4/DD, badge, laptop. Short staffing tomorrow morning so want to pre-assign roles.
Ava (Hiring): I'll meet him at reception at 08:50 and confirm documents. He said he might only have a driver's license tonight.
Juno (People Ops): DL + SS card is fine. If he shows only DL, we can schedule remote I-9 the same day but mark HRIS 'I-9 pending'.
Liam (IT): I can do imaging early slot 08:30-08:50 and drop laptop at reception labeled "Marco S". MDM will prompt on first boot.
Theo (Security): BG still pending per the vendor. Policy: no permanent badge until BG green. We can issue a temp badge for orientation only.
payroll-bot: Reminder: W-4 + direct deposit must be completed before Fri payroll cutoff 17:00 to avoid manual processing.
Ava (Hiring): Marco asked about benefits effective date — does it start immediately or next month?
Juno (People Ops): Benefits effective on hire date; premiums prorated. We'll send enrollment email Day 1. He has 30 days to elect.
Liam (IT): If Marco can't make 08:30 imaging, I can do a 16:00 remote helper session and provide temporary creds that expire in 24h.
Theo (Security): I'll create a badge expedite ticket if BG clears late, but we need a photo. Reception can take one on arrival.
Ava (Hiring): Can we leave a visitor parking pass at reception? Marco is driving in.
Juno (People Ops): Yes — leaving one validated pass. Also prepping a short day-1 email to Marco with GoodHire link, W-4, DD, campus map, and kiosk directions.
Ava (Hiring): Thanks — I'll text him to remind about SS card or passport.
Liam (IT): Returning a quick IT note: bring charger, sign into SSO to finish MDM.
Juno (People Ops): Action items summary: 1) Ava meet reception 08:50 2) Liam imaging 08:30 or remote 16:00 3) Theo temp badge/photo if BG pending 4) payroll-bot watch W-4/DD status 5) People Ops send final checklist tonight. Good catch everyone — see you tomorrow. :tada:
